name: workspace-bridge
description: Use several Google accounts (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Contacts) from Claude through your own self-hosted MCP server on Cloudflare Workers. Multi-account, with owner approval for risky actions and a read-only endpoint for routines.

server_url.title: Server URL
server_url.description: Base URL of your own deployed workspace-bridge server, with no trailing slash and no /mcp suffix, for example https://mcp.example.com
